configure.title: Configure Assist script tool
configure.description: Select a parameter and choose an action. Mapped parameters resolve a human-friendly target; pass-through parameters retain the source script behavior.

edit_parameter.title: Configure script parameter
edit_parameter.description: Choose pass through to retain the script parameter unchanged, or resolve a target to replace a friendly name with a canonical entity ID.

advanced.title: Edit mappings as JSON
advanced.description: This replaces the mappings configured in the parameter editor. Updating returns to the main configuration form.

error.script_not_found: The selected script does not exist.
error.no_script_fields: The selected script does not declare any fields.
error.duplicate_input_name: That LLM parameter name is already in use.
error.invalid_json: Resolved field mappings must be valid JSON.
error.not_a_list: Resolved field mappings must be a JSON list.
error.invalid_mapping: Each mapping needs unique input_name and script_field strings, a non-empty domains list, and an optional boolean multiple value.
error.unknown_script_field: Each mapped script field must be declared by the selected script.
